title: Package with illegal items, paraphrased (few keywords)

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good afternoon. A shipment booked with your identity card was stopped at the airport. Inside were forged passports and banned substances.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Many people say that. The department has to take you into custody tonight unless your involvement is ruled out.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Keep this conversation to yourself. If anyone at home learns about it, the matter becomes public and your job is gone.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: To rule you out, the officer needs your funds parked with the government for a short check. Every rupee comes back after the check.
